item.title: Mujin: $233 Million Closed To Scale Its Intelligent Robotics Platform
item.description: Mujin, the Tokyo- and Atlanta-based automation technology company, has closed $233 million in the first tranche of its Series D round to speed global deployment of MujinOS, its intelligent robotics operating system. The raise includes $133 million in equity led by NTT Group with co-lead Qatar Investment Authority (QIA), and participation from Mitsubishi HC Capital Realty and Salesforce Ventures, alongside $100 million in debt financing from leading Japanese financial institutions. item.title: Ansley Park Capital: $400 Million Asset-Backed Securitization Closed, Marking First-Time Issuance In U.S. Equipment Finance
item.description: Ansley Park Capital has completed its inaugural asset-backed securitization valued at more than $400 million, marking the largest first-time issuance ever recorded in the U.S. large-ticket equipment finance market. The transaction closed on November 26, 2025. item.title: Woven Solutions Acquires Cystemic Security, Expanding Its Cyber and Managed Attribution Capabilities
item.description: Woven Solutions has acquired Cystemic Security, marking the Reston-based mission-software provider’s first transaction since securing a strategic investment from Falfurrias Management Partners in August. The deal strengthens Woven’s position as a rapidly scaling builder of AI-enabled cyber and intelligence tooling for U.S. national security agencies. item.title: Allworth Financial Expands In Boston With Acquisition Of $460 Million Firm FSA Wealth Management
item.description: Allworth Financial has acquired FSA Wealth Management, a Needham, Massachusetts–based fiduciary advisory firm overseeing $460 million in assets, strengthening the firm’s up-market capabilities in one of the nation’s most competitive wealth hubs. The deal brings six professionals, including five financial advisors—into Allworth’s growing Greater Boston operation, with the team set to transition into Allworth’s existing Waltham office. item.title: Antares: $96 Million Raised To Advance Nuclear Microreactor Development
item.description: Antares, a rapidly growing advanced nuclear energy startup, has secured $96 million in Series B financing to accelerate development of its compact nuclear microreactor platform. The round was led by Shine Capital, with participation from Alt Capital, Caffeinated, FiftyThree Stations, Industrious, and others. item.title: Asurion To Buy Domestic & General, Expanding Footprint In Connected Device And Appliance Care
item.description: Asurion has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Domestic & General, aiming to build one of the world’s largest end-to-end providers of technology and appliance protection. The deal strengthens Asurion’s push to become the “CTO of the home” by unifying care for connected devices and household appliances under a single global platform. item.description: UpTerra has appointed Stephen Birch as its new Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, and has also secured a strategic investment from Big Idea Ventures’ Generation Food Rural Partners (GFRP) Fund. item.title: Velvære: $555 Million Secured To Advance Luxury Wellness Residential Community In Deer Valley’s East Village
item.description: Velvære, a wellness-focused, ski-in/ski-out residential community within Deer Valley’s East Village expansion, has secured an additional $197 million in capital financing from Anchor Loans, bringing its total financing to $555 million following a restructuring of existing capital. The funding was arranged and advised by LFB Ventures, with equity backing from Toba Capital.
